title: Psalms 99

verses.text: God's government is especially exercised in and for His Church, which should praise Him for His gracious dealings.
tremble … be moved—inspired with fear by His judgments on the wicked.
great and terrible name—producing dread (De 10:17), and to be praised by those over whom He is exalted (Ps 97:9).
it is holy—or, "He is holy" (Ps 99:5, 9; Isa 6:3).
To His wise and righteous government all nations should render honor.
king's … judgment—His power is combined with justice.
The experience of these servants of God is cited for encouragement.
among … priests, among … upon the Lord [and] He spake … pillar—may be referred to all three (compare Ex 18:19; Le 8:15; De 5:5; 1Sa 9:13).
7. cloudy pillar—the medium of divine intercourse (Ex 33:9; Nu 12:5).
God answered them as intercessors for the people, who, though forgiven, were yet chastened (Ex 32:10, 34).
